title: Management & Strategy Trainee
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical candidate to join our team as a Management & Strategy Trainee. In this role, you will work closely with senior consultants and project leaders to support strategic and operational projects for our clients.


You will be responsible for conducting analyses, structuring business problems, building financial and operational models, and supporting the development of strategic recommendations. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in management consulting and develop strong analytical, problem-solving, and business decision-making skills.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define data needs
  • Support consulting projects related to strategy, operations, and performance improvement
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis to support business decisions
  • Structure and analyze large datasets to generate insights
  • Assist in preparing presentations and reports for clients
  • Participate in problem-solving sessions and project discussions
  • Support the development of business cases and strategic recommendations
  • Collaborate with internal teams and contribute to project deliverables


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degreein Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields
  • Solid knowledge of Excel and data analysis
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data analysis, financial modeling, or business analytics
  • Knowledge of Power BI, Python, SQL, or other analytical tools
  • Previous internship experience in consulting, finance, strategy, or analytics
  • Experience working with large datasets or dashboards

title: Quantitative Developer (Python) – Crypto Derivatives
description:
Company Description


TalentBridge Consulting LLC is dedicated to connecting organizations with top-tier talent and delivering customized consulting solutions. Specializing in recruiting, people operations, and project management, TalentBridge Consulting focuses on enhancing people, processes, and performance. Our approach is tailored to align with the objectives and long-term growth plans of our clients, ensuring a meaningful impact on their success.


Remote (LATAM Preferred) · Full-time Contractor · Working hours aligned with Eastern Time


Role Description


We are looking for a Quantitative Developer to design, build, and deploy trading systems focused on BTC derivatives (options, perpetuals, and spot).


This role combines quantitative modeling with hands-on system development. You will work directly with the investment team to translate trading ideas into production-ready systems and improve execution, risk management, and portfolio performance.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement quantitative trading models for BTC derivatives.
  • Build and maintain production-grade systems (data pipelines, execution, monitoring)
  • Develop and optimize strategies considering real market constraints (slippage, liquidity, funding, margin).
  • Support portfolio monitoring and risk analysis (exposure, performance drivers).
  • Improve existing models and infrastructure to increase reliability and execution quality.
  • Collaborate with investment stakeholders to translate ideas into deployable solutions.


Requirements


  • 5+ years of experience in Python development (production environments)
  • Experience in quantitative finance, trading systems, or related roles
  • Proven experience building and deploying trading systems end-to-end
  • Solid understanding of derivatives (options, futures, or perpetuals)
  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and system design
  • Experience working with APIs and SQL databases
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in crypto markets (BTC, derivatives)
  • Familiarity with volatility strategies and options frameworks (Greeks, term structure)
  • Experience with cloud environments or containerization (AWS, Docker)
  • Background in machine learning or time-series modeling
  • Work Setup


Qualifications


  • Strong expertise in Trading and Crypto Derivatives
  • Proficiency in Quantitative Analytics and Quantitative Finance
  • Solid understanding of Mathematics and Statistics concepts
  • Experience with Python programming and algorithm development
  • Ability to analyze large sets of financial data
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency market dynamics
  • Excellent problem-solving and quantitative skills
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a quantitative field, such as Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or Engineering

Somos uma startup brasileira de biotecnologia focada em impulsionar a inovação no agronegócio. Atuamos transformando microbiologia e genômica em soluções práticas que aumentam produtividade, eficiência e sustentabilidade no campo.


Valorizamos pensamento crítico, curiosidade científica e colaboração entre áreas técnicas e comerciais. Buscamos pessoas orientadas a impacto real, que gostem de desafios e tenham maturidade para atuar em vendas consultivas de alto valor agregado.

Experiência comprovada como Closer ou Executivo de Vendas em vendas B2B (mínimo 3 anos).

Comunicação clara, objetiva e estratégica, escrita e verbal.

Capacidade de conduzir reuniões comerciais e lidar com objeções complexas.

Domínio de ferramentas de CRM como Pipedrive, Hubspot, Bitrix ou similares.

Disponibilidade para trabalho híbrido presencial em Piracicaba, SP.

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia, Biotecnologia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia com agronegócio, biotecnologia, insumos agrícolas ou vendas técnicas.

Capacidade de dialogar com perfis técnicos, pesquisadores e gestores do agro.

Certificações em vendas consultivas, Inside Sales, SPIN Selling ou metodologias similares.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
59070


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional de Flutter venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?



Perfil de Cientista de Dados Sênior


Cientista de Dados Sênior com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de soluções de machine learning e inteligência artificial em ambientes produtivos.

Atuar com Python, SQL e versionamento com Git, além de containerização com Docker e desenvolvimento em cloud (AWS ou GCP), garantindo escalabilidade e robustez das aplicações.

Possuir forte capacidade de estruturar soluções em arquiteturas modulares, com foco em qualidade de código, eficiência e reuso.

Experiente na produtização de modelos, desde o desenvolvimento até o deployment e monitoramento.

Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando e mentorando profissionais mais juniores, além de colaborar ativamente na evolução contínua de produtos e processos.

Perfil analítico, pragmático e orientado a entrega em contextos de maior complexidade.



Modelo Remoto

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Analista Departamento Pessoal PL / Folha (vaga afirmativa para pessoa com deficiência)
description:
Buscamos um Analista PL (vaga afirmativa para pessoa com deficiência).


Irá atuar na gestão das rotinas do eSocial, assegurando o correto processamento dos eventos periódicos e não periódicos, bem como o atendimento integral às exigências legais.

Executar a validação, consolidação e transmissão das informações ao ambiente governamental, garantindo a integridade, consistência e conformidade dos dados reportados.

Realizar o fechamento e envio dos eventos do eSocial (S-1000 a S-1299 e S-2200 a S-3000), acompanhando todo o fluxo de processamento.

Monitorar continuamente o sistema, analisando ocorrências, rejeições e inconsistências, promovendo a regularização das pendências dentro dos prazos legais.

Acompanhar alterações na legislação, atualizações de layout e mudanças em tabelas oficiais, avaliando impactos e direcionando ajustes necessários nos processos e parametrizações.

Analisar configurações sistêmicas da folha de pagamento, propondo melhorias e apoiando a implementação de ajustes para garantir aderência às normas trabalhistas e previdenciárias.

Atuar de forma complementar nas rotinas de folha em ambiente ERP (SAP HCM), participando do processamento mensal, incluindo cálculos de férias, 13º salário e rescisões.

Realizar conferências, simulações e análises de cálculos trabalhistas, assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente e políticas internas.

Validar bases de cálculo de encargos, provisões e integrações sistêmicas, além de apoiar na apuração de tributos trabalhistas (FGTS, INSS e IRRF) e processos de conciliação.

Prestar suporte a auditorias e controles internos, interagindo com áreas correlatas para alinhamento de informações e esclarecimento de aspectos técnicos.

Contribuir com iniciativas de melhoria contínua, revisão de processos e aumento da eficiência operacional.


Formação Acadêmica

Graduação completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Recursos Humanos, Economia ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência Profissional


Experiência consistente na operação do eSocial, incluindo envio de eventos, monitoramento e tratamento de inconsistências.

Vivência em rotinas de folha de pagamento em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Conhecimento prático em SAP HCM, com atuação nos módulos de Administração de Pessoal (PA) e Folha de Pagamento (PY), sendo desejável familiaridade com OM e TM.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

Sólido conhecimento da legislação trabalhista e previdenciária aplicada ao eSocial.

Experiência com parametrizações e análise de logs no SAP HCM.

Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado para controle e análise de dados.

Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias e apuração de encargos trabalhistas.


Perfil Profissional


Perfil analítico, com atenção aos detalhes e foco na qualidade das informações.

Capacidade de interpretar normas legais e layouts técnicos, atuando com autonomia na resolução de problemas.

Organização e disciplina para gestão de prazos e demandas.

Boa comunicação para interação com diferentes áreas e tradução de conteúdos técnicos.

Proatividade na identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.


Diferenciais


Atuação como referência técnica em eSocial dentro de áreas de folha ou administração de pessoal.

Experiência em ambientes com alto volume de colaboradores e operações complexas.

Participação em projetos de melhoria de processos, automação ou transformação digital em RH.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Talent Matcher - Non Code
description:

Key Responsibilities

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

description:
Sobre a Keeta

A Keeta é a subsidiária internacional da Meituan, gigante global no setor de delivery, e está em uma missão ambiciosa: revolucionar o mercado de food delivery em todo o mundo. Nosso propósito é simples, mas poderoso: “Ajudamos as pessoas a comerem melhor e viverem melhor”. Guiados por esse princípio, trazemos inovação e tecnologia para o cenário global. Com mais de 1.000 membros da equipe ao redor do mundo, a Keeta está em plena expansão — e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada!

Como parte do nosso compromisso em criar um ambiente de trabalho mais inclusivo, criamos este Banco de Talentos dedicado a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) . Por meio de medidas afirmativas e a ampliação do acesso a oportunidades, buscamos aumentar a representatividade em nossas equipes e garantir que todos tenham a chance de crescer, contribuir e se destacar em suas carreiras. Essa iniciativa faz parte dos nossos esforços contínuos para conectar profissionais talentosos que se identifiquem como pessoas com deficiência e que desejam construir suas carreiras conosco. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas, experiências e formas de pensar, e estamos comprometidos a promover um ambiente onde as pessoas se sintam incluídas e recebam todo suporte necessário para realizar seu trabalho.


Sobre a área

Nosso time Comercial tem atuação direta no crescimento da nossa base de parceiros. Buscamos por pessoas com perfil hunter , que serão responsáveis pela prospecção ativa de novos parceiros e restaurantes, e que gostem de construir relacionamento, negociar e identificar oportunidades de negócio.


O que é essencial para se inscrever no nosso Banco de Talentos?

  • Se identificar como pessoa com deficiência

Suas informações serão tratadas com estrita confidencialidade, e nossa equipe de recrutamento analisará seu perfil para oportunidades atuais ou futuras alinhadas com sua experiência e interesses de carreira.

title: Cloud Engineer (US hours)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, Azure and Google Cloud best practice framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at

Benefits:

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Estagiário jurídico
description:
Há 21 anos, o Grupo Wish transforma desejos em realidade na hotelaria brasileira.

Somos apaixonados por hospitalidade e estamos sempre crescendo, com 11 hotéis espalhados pelos principais destinos turísticos do país . Do Nordeste ao Sul do Brasil, do corporativo à operação, o nosso DNA é servir com excelência. É assim que vamos nos tornar o maior grupo de hospitalidade do Brasil.

✨ Aqui, nossa cultura STAR brilha todos os dias com:

•Simplicidade Criativa: descentralizar, descomplicar e agir com autonomia.

•Times Empáticos: pessoas diversas que constroem relações de respeito, transparência e confiança.

•Atitude Resolutiva: olhar de dono, coragem e prontidão para encantar clientes e colegas.

•Resultados Extraordinários: transformar desejos em resultados para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e investidores.

E para quem faz parte do nosso time, oferecemos o Wish Equilíbrio , o nosso programa de qualidade de vida que cuida da sua saúde e bem-estar.


Descrição das Atividades:

  • Colaborar com escritórios de advocacia externos que prestam serviços para a empresa, fazendo solicitações de informações, esclarecimentos sobre processos e reportando atualizações internas.
  • Ajudar na organização e envio de documentos solicitados pelos advogados externos.
  • Auxiliar na organização de provas e documentos necessários para instruir as petições e defesas.
  • Auxiliar na avaliação dos riscos jurídicos envolvidos em processos contenciosos, com foco em possíveis cenários e consequências para a empresa.
  • Ajudar na identificação de estratégias para mitigar riscos ou explorar alternativas de resolução de conflitos, como acordos ou mediação.
  • Controlar as datas de audiências, perícias e demais compromissos processuais, garantindo que o advogado externo e/ou os responsáveis estejam preparados (organizar a logística de participação em audiências e perícias).
  • Revisar relatórios mensais enviados pelos escritórios externos com informações sobre o andamento dos processos, decisões judiciais e possíveis impactos para a empresa.
  • Providenciar o controle de pagamentos, tanto de escritórios externos quanto de outros parceiros do Departamento Jurídico, organizando as faturas e mantendo o registro de todas as despesas.
  • Verificar a conformidade das faturas com os contratos firmados e os serviços prestados, garantindo que não haja pagamentos fora do escopo acordado.
  • Solicitar e monitorar o pagamento dos custos associados aos processos, como taxas judiciais, custas de cartório, honorários periciais, entre outros.
  • Controlar a previsão e o pagamento de despesas processuais, mantendo os registros organizados.


Competências Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento de Processos Judiciais: Embora o estagiário esteja em uma fase inicial da carreira, ter um conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento dos processos judiciais no contexto empresarial é crucial. Isso inclui entender prazos processuais, documentos necessários, classificação de ações (ex.: ações trabalhistas, cíveis, tributárias) e os fluxos das fases processuais, como audiências e decisões.
  • Gestão de Documentos e Provas:Saber como organizar e arquivar documentos e provas que serão utilizados nos processos é uma competência importante. Isso envolve a preparação de documentos, como e-mails e relatórios internos, e o gerenciamento de provas para garantir que tudo esteja em ordem para ser utilizado no processo.
  • Comunicação com Escritórios Externos: O estagiário interagirá com advogados externos e áreas internas da Companhia para levantamento de subsídios e provas. Portanto, é importante saber se comunicar de forma clara e profissional, inclusive na elaboração de e-mails.
  • Noções de Direito Trabalhista e do Consumidor: Isso será útil, pois a grande maioria das disputas judiciais que envolvem a Companhia têm origem em relações consumeristas e de trabalho.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to Staff Accountant


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm EST


Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability


For more information, write to

description:

Specializing in recruiting, people operations, and project management, TalentBridge Consulting focuses on enhancing people, processes, and performance. Our approach is tailored to align with the objectives and long-term growth plans of our clients, ensuring a meaningful impact on their success.


Remote (LATAM Preferred) · Full-time Contractor · Working hours aligned with Eastern Time


Role Description


We are looking for a Quantitative Developer to design, build, and deploy trading systems focused on BTC derivatives (options, perpetuals, and spot).


This role combines quantitative modeling with hands-on system development. You will work directly with the investment team to translate trading ideas into production-ready systems and improve execution, risk management, and portfolio performance.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement quantitative trading models for BTC derivatives.
  • Build and maintain production-grade systems (data pipelines, execution, monitoring)
  • Develop and optimize strategies considering real market constraints (slippage, liquidity, funding, margin).
  • Support portfolio monitoring and risk analysis (exposure, performance drivers).
  • Improve existing models and infrastructure to increase reliability and execution quality.
  • Collaborate with investment stakeholders to translate ideas into deployable solutions.


Requirements


  • 5+ years of experience in Python development (production environments)
  • Experience in quantitative finance, trading systems, or related roles
  • Proven experience building and deploying trading systems end-to-end
  • Solid understanding of derivatives (options, futures, or perpetuals)
  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and system design
  • Experience working with APIs and SQL databases
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in crypto markets (BTC, derivatives)
  • Familiarity with volatility strategies and options frameworks (Greeks, term structure)
  • Experience with cloud environments or containerization (AWS, Docker)
  • Background in machine learning or time-series modeling
  • Work Setup


Qualifications


  • Strong expertise in Trading and Crypto Derivatives
  • Proficiency in Quantitative Analytics and Quantitative Finance
  • Solid understanding of Mathematics and Statistics concepts
  • Experience with Python programming and algorithm development
  • Ability to analyze large sets of financial data
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency market dynamics
  • Excellent problem-solving and quantitative skills
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a quantitative field, such as Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or Engineering

title: Analista em Parcerias
description:
Quem somos


A Martz é um CRM omnichannel de retenção focado em e-commerce. Nossa plataforma centraliza dados de clientes, segmenta bases e ativa campanhas automáticas via WhatsApp, e-mail e SMS, tudo para aumentar a recompra, o LTV e o faturamento das lojas que confiam em nós.


Com 3 anos de mercado, temos centenas de lojas ativas na plataforma e seguimos crescendo. Somos uma empresa transparente, ágil e orientada a resultado, com integrações nativas com as principais plataformas de e-commerce e ERP do mercado, como Nuvemshop, Shopify, Tray, Bling e VTEX, atendendo tanto lojas virtuais quanto físicas.


Se você tem energia para construir relacionamentos, desenvolver parceiros e transformar conexões em resultados, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


• Gestão e relacionamento estratégico com agências e consultores parceiros da Martz;

• Capacitação e engajamento contínuo dos parceiros;

• Condução de apresentações, treinamentos e ações de relacionamento;

• Atuação junto às agências para resolução de cases, definição de estratégias e alinhamento com o cliente final;

• Planejamento e execução de ações para captação de indicações;

• Aquisição de novos parceiros.


Como será o seu dia a dia


• Gestão estratégica da carteira de parceiros, com foco em engajamento para indicações, reuniões estratégicas e follow-up;

• Atuação como referência técnica e comportamental, conduzindo treinamentos e apoiando o desenvolvimento das equipes parceiras;

• Garantia de alto padrão de excelência no uso da ferramenta e nas estratégias aplicadas;

• Organização junto ao financeiro e ao parceiro sobre pagamentos de comissão;

• Administração e otimização dos canais de comunicação interna (intranet, e-mails, WhatsApp, grupos e comunidade de parceiros);

• Monitoramento de indicadores de FUP e engajamento, organizando dados, insights e relatórios de apoio à tomada de decisão;

• Planejamento e execução de campanhas internas e ações de engajamento, do briefing à entrega;

• Apoio ao planejamento e execução de eventos como lives, jantares, ativações e encontros de parceiros;

• Contribuição ativa com ideias criativas e soluções inovadoras para fortalecer a cultura e os comportamentos do ecossistema de parceiros;

• Combinação de visão analítica, criatividade e forte capacidade de relacionamento para maximizar produtividade, rentabilidade e impulsionar o crescimento sustentável da operação.


Requisitos e Qualificações


• Ensino Médio Completo;

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de influência;

• Facilidade em aprender novas tecnologias e ferramentas de software;

• Perfil organizado, com visão estratégica e planejamento;

• Disponibilidade para viagens a eventos;

• Residência em São Paulo (capital ou Grande SP).


O que buscamos em você


Além das qualificações técnicas, queremos alguém com perfil consultivo, que saiba ouvir, construir confiança e movimentar pessoas em torno de um objetivo comum.


Local : Vaga Remota, mas residência em São Paulo (capital ou Grande SP) para participação em eventos.

description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas.


Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Expert com sólida experiência em projetos complexos de upgrade, conversão e migração de ambientes SAP.


Você atuará em um contexto global , liderando execuções técnicas críticas, garantindo estabilidade, performance e evolução de ambientes SAP, colaborando com times multiculturais e clientes internacionais.



Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de upgrades, conversões, migrações e manutenções em ambientes SAP.
  • Planejar e executar estratégias completas de evolução de sistemas: análise de impacto, roadmap técnico, cronogramas e execução em ambientes Dev/QA/Prod.
  • Conduzir processos de system upgrade, system conversion, OS/DB migration, e HANA upgrades, assegurando conformidade com melhores práticas SAP.
  • Realizar cutover planning, coordenação de mock runs e atividades críticas de produção.
  • Diagnosticar incidentes complexos em ambientes SAP Basis, atuando na resolução de problemas e mitigação de riscos.
  • Garantir documentação completa dos processos técnicos, lições aprendidas e recomendações de melhoria contínua.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais, arquitetos e stakeholders globais para assegurar compatibilidade e readiness das soluções.
  • Acompanhar o roadmap SAP, avaliando impactos e oportunidades de atualização para os ambientes dos clientes.



Requisitos:

  • 8+ anos de experiência comprovada em SAP Basis.
  • Domínio em:
  • SAP system upgrades (NetWeaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel)
  • SAP S/4HANA conversions (pré-checks, simplification item, custom code remediation)
  • System copies e client copies
  • OS/DB migrations e Unicode conversions
  • HANA database upgrades
  • Proficiência com ferramentas: SUM, DMO, Maintenance Planner, SPAM/SAINT.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com equipes e clientes internacionais.
  • Experiência em ambientes globais ou operações Nearshore é um diferencial.



Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP Basis ou SAP HANA.
  • Experiência com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Vivência com projetos multiculturais.



Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

Modalidade: 100% Home office



Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


The Senior Software Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software solutions that power our partner’s core products and services. This role contributes to technical strategy, mentors junior engineers, and collaborates cross-functionally to deliver high-quality code, drive innovation, and support overall platform growth.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software applications and systems.
  • Write unit, integration, and other types of automated tests.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical planning and decision-making.
  • Use agentic workflows to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code adhering to SOLID principles.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to ensure best practices in coding, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver features.
  • Identify and troubleshoot issues to ensure system performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers to support their growth and development.
  • Continuously explore new technologies and tools to improve engineering processes and outcomes.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
  • Strong hands-on experience with advanced SQL, including writing and optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, and database-level business logic in MSSQL or similar relational databases.
  • Proficiency in Angular with Typescript and/or MSSQL
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and deep hands-on experience with relational databases (SQL), including performance tuning and schema design
  • Familiarity with architecture and design patterns such as Hexagonal, Onion, CQRS, Transactional Outbox, and others
  • Familiarity with Azure and/or AWS
  • Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.


Bonus / Strong Plus:

  • AI and Agentic Workflows:  Experience applying AI tools to automate or enhance workflows beyond basic tooling (e.g., Copilot), including initiative in learning and integrating AI technologies to improve development processes and operational efficiency.
  • Open to candidates with either a strong backend (C#) background and deep SQL expertise, or database-focused engineers with experience contributing to C#/.NET services


Key Competencies:

  • Full-Stack or Backend Development Expertise
  • Software Architecture & Design Patterns
  • Agile Development & Continuous Integration
  • Code Quality, Testing & Documentation
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Debugging & Performance Optimization
  • Mentorship & Peer Leadership
  • Adaptability & Continuous Learning


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join an innovative hospitality tech company building scalable, high-impact software.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals


Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

POSITION SPECIFICATION

ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.

-Competitive salary
