title: Analista de Devops Sr
description:
Com o que você irá atuar:


  • Administrar ambientes em nuvem (principalmente AWS), garantindo performance, disponibilidade e segurança
  • Automatizar processos com ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou AWS CDK
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD integradas à infraestrutura
  • Monitorar recursos de cloud usando CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana ou similares
  • Gerenciar recursos como EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, ELB, Route53, entre outros
  • Suportar o time de desenvolvimento em deploys, testes e troubleshooting de infraestrutura
  • Apoiar na definição e implementação de políticas de segurança, backup e governança em cloud
  • Participar de projetos de migração, modernização e otimização de workloads para nuvem
  • Integrar práticas de segurança no ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software
  • Interagir com as equipes de desenvolvimento para implementar controles nas plataformas Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Automatizar testes e integrar ferramentas no pipeline de CI/CD.
  • Gerenciar e monitorar a configuração das infraestruturas em nuvem e on-premise.



O que esperamos de você?


  • Experiência prática com serviços AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, etc.)
  • Vivência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em automação de ambientes e CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Noções de redes, segurança em cloud e boas práticas de arquitetura
  • Habilidade com sistemas Linux e scripts (bash, python, etc.)
  • Experiência com práticas em ambientes de desenvolvimento com Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Experiência em configuração de servidores Web com IIS, Nginx e Apache.



O que oferecemos como benefícios:


  • VR
  • Vale transporte
  • Assistência médica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Gympass

title: 11161 - Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedores Salesforce (Sêniores e Especialistas), altamente qualificados para atuarem em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade, com foco na implementação, customização e manutenção de soluções na plataforma Salesforce! ✨


Requisitos:

Graduação completa;

Possuir domínio avançado em Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce e SOQL;

Experiência prática com Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD e gerenciamento de pacotes é essencial;

Deve ter conhecimento sólido no uso de ferramentas declarativas como Flow, Process Builder, Validation Rules e Permission Sets;

É fundamental ter experiência comprovada em integração de sistemas via APIs REST e SOAP, com autenticação OAuth 2.0 e uso de Named Credentials;

Conhecimento de arquitetura multiorganização (multi-org), gerenciamento de ambientes sandbox e estratégia de versionamento de código são importantes;

Desejável experiência com frameworks de testes automatizados e uso de ferramentas como Jest para LWC;

É esperado domínio dos módulos Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, além de conhecimento prático em gerenciamento de dados com Data Loader ou Workbench.


Certificações Salesforce são desejáveis, mas não obrigatórias, o foco está na experiência técnica comprovada em projetos complexos e de grande escala!

Outros diferenciais: Experiência com Financial Cloud, B2B commerce, CRM, Agentforce.


Responsabilidades :

Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas utilizando Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e outras tecnologias da plataforma, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. A posição exige grande autonomia técnica, capacidade de análise crítica de requisitos e experiência com o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento dentro do ecossistema Salesforce, incluindo integração com sistemas externos e deploy controlado via Salesforce DX;

Liderará o desenvolvimento técnico de soluções na plataforma Salesforce, desde a análise de requisitos até a entrega em produção;

Deverá implementar funcionalidades customizadas utilizando Apex, LWC, Visualforce e configurações declarativas quando apropriado. Também será responsável por modelar objetos e relacionamentos no Salesforce Data Model, configurar workflows, Process Builder, Flow e validações de dados;

Espera-se que atue na integração da plataforma com APIs REST e SOAP externas, utilizando Named Credentials e Auth Providers quando necessário. Também será responsável por garantir a qualidade do código através de testes unitários com alta cobertura, revisão de código e aplicação de design patterns aderentes ao Salesforce;

Participará ativamente de cerimônias ágeis, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e orientando desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Modalidade de trabalho: 100% Home-Office, podendo residir em qualquer região do Brasil!!!

Contratação: CLT Flex

title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

title: Advogado III
description:
Quem Somos Nós?

Somos uma das maiores fabricantes de fitas adesivas do Brasil , com um catálogo que abrange 43 famílias de produtos e mais de 1.000 itens, atendendo a diversos mercados.


Por que você deveria vir com a gente?

Aqui, desenvolvemos relacionamentos e valores em um ambiente saudável. Acreditamos no potencial das pessoas e estamos sempre abertos a novas ideias. Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha com o coração!


Requisitos :

  • Ensino Superior completo em Direito.
  • OAB ativa.
  • Conhecimento sólido em Direito Empresarial, Contratual, Trabalhista e Tributário.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de contratos e processos.

Diferenciais Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Direito Empresarial, Contratual ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em indústria ou empresas de médio/grande porte.


Principais Atividades:

Contratual:

  • Elaborar, revisar e analisar contratos comerciais, trabalhistas e societários.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos contratos: negociação, execução e encerramento.
  • Garantir conformidade legal, mitigando riscos contratuais.
  • Manter a base de dados contratuais atualizada.

Contencioso:

  • Acompanhar e controlar processos trabalhistas, tributários e cíveis.
  • Fazer interface com escritórios jurídicos externos.
  • Elaborar relatórios processuais e análise de exposição a riscos.
  • Analisar viabilidade de acordos e estratégias processuais.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos e obrigações legais.

Suporte Societário:

  • Apoiar alterações contratuais, aumento de capital e reestruturações societárias.
  • Redigir atas de reuniões e assembleias.
  • Acompanhar obrigações junto a órgãos reguladores (ex: JUCESP).

Atividades Gerais:

  • Prestar suporte jurídico às áreas internas da empresa.
  • Elaborar pareceres e relatórios jurídicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre legislações aplicáveis.
  • Participar de negociações representando a empresa.


Inclusão importa para a gente!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).

title: Data Analyst
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Data Analyst


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Help Fraud Deflect turn data into clear, reliable insights across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, and operational performance. The focus is working within the current stack to improve reporting, analysis, data quality, and decision-making, not rebuilding everything from scratch.


Responsibilities

  • Own reporting and analysis for core business datasets.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking.
  • Write and optimize SQL for analysis, reporting, and data validation.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and merchant trends to identify risks, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Investigate anomalies, data issues, and performance changes across key metrics.
  • Partner with engineering, product, operations, and leadership to answer business questions with data.
  • Work with existing pipelines and datasets to improve trust, consistency, and usability of data.
  • Use Python for analysis, validation, and lightweight automation where needed.
  • Support data quality efforts by identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases in source data.
  • Create clear visualizations and communicate findings in a practical, business-friendly way.
  • Work within the current stack (MySQL, AWS, Airflow; ClickHouse is a plus).


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports.
  • Ability to translate business questions into clear analysis.
  • Experience working with production data and validating data quality.
  • Python proficiency for analysis or automation.
  • Strong communication and troubleshooting skills.
  • Comfortable working with existing systems and improving them incrementally.


Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, or risk data.
  • Experience with Airflow or other scheduled workflow tools.
  • AWS experience.
  • Observability/visualization experience (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior ClickHouse experience.
  • Basic Linux/CLI comfort.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·        Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·        5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·        Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·        Brazil-based ( fully remote )

·        Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·        Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·        Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·        Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·        High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·        Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph  describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

description:
Aqui na Zallpy, tecnologia nasce de pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de fazer bem feito. Se você gosta de ambientes onde existe espaço para perguntar, testar, aprender e evoluir junto, se liga nessa oportunidade!

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar em um time que pensa grande, trabalha com atenção aos detalhes, parceria no dia a dia e responsabilidade compartilhada. Acreditamos em autonomia, troca entre diferentes experiências e soluções construídas em conjunto.

Por aqui, crescer significa compartilhar conhecimento, respeitar diferentes formas de pensar e construir relações de confiança enquanto entregamos tecnologia de qualidade.

Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, vem somar com a gente.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Interpretar e compreender os requisitos do projeto.
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas para esclarecer especificações.
  • Criar designs técnicos sólidos, considerando escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Desenvolver e executar testes unitários para garantir a robustez do código.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com membros da equipe, incluindo desenvolvedores, arquitetos e profissionais de QA.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e revisões de código.
  • Atualizar e manter o código conforme necessário para atender a requisitos em evolução.
  • Criar documentação clara e abrangente do código, design e processos.
  • Facilitar a compreensão do sistema para outros membros da equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências tecnológicas relacionadas a Java.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Java versão 8 ou superior;
  • Spring Ecosystem - Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Data, Spring Cloud e Spring Security;
  • Microsserviços;
  • Bancos de Dados SQL e NoSQL;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Git;
  • Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Mensageria;
  • Conceitos de cloud (AWS/Azure);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Boas práticas como Clean Code e SOLID;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota.


Modalidades de contratação

  • Cooperado

Wellhub

Acesso a academias, atividades físicas e bem-estar.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (21+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)


We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.


Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP


Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed


Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)


If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência sólida com Golang em ambientes produtivos.
  • Atuação com Ruby On Rails.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência profunda com integrações de API.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente PostgreSQL.
  • Prática com Docker e Kubernetes para construção e orquestração de containers.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas em cloud.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código com Git.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis e colaborativos


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Node.js ou vontade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas.
  • Experiência anterior em projetos de integração com APIs de parceiros complexos (ex: plataformas de investimento, APIs de corretagem).
  • Experiência em projetos financeiros.
  • Prática com observabilidade (monitoramento, métricas, alertas).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs e melhores práticas de proteção de dados.
  • Experiência prévia com ferramentas como CI/CD, Terraform ou similares.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Técnico Suporte ao Usuário
description:
Sobre nós


A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a Vaga:


Técnico de Suporte ao Usuário JR

Horário de trabalho: 15:40 a 01:10 - segunda à sexta-feira


Modalidade presencial em Itaúna, MG.


O profissional será responsável pelo suporte técnico de TI presencial na área de manufatura da Stellantis, atuando diretamente no atendimento aos usuários, bem como na montagem, manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de TI. A posição é dedicada à operação fabril, garantindo a disponibilidade, estabilidade e funcionamento adequado dos recursos tecnológicos utilizados na produção.


️ Responsabilidades

Atendimento presencial aos usuários da manufatura.

Montagem, configuração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva de desktops, notebooks e impressoras.

Instalação, formatação e atualização de sistemas operacionais.

Instalação e configuração de softwares corporativos.

Execução de backup e restauração de dados conforme procedimentos definidos.

Diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes relacionados a hardware e software.

Abertura, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados via ferramenta ITSM.

Apoio técnico em salas de produção e áreas administrativas da planta.

Suporte em atividades de troca, substituição e preparação de equipamentos (imaging, setup e testes).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência comprovada em suporte técnico de TI (hardware e software).

Vivência com montagem e manutenção de computadores e notebooks.

Experiência com impressoras (instalação, manutenção básica e troubleshooting).

Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows.

Experiência com atendimento ao usuário e uso de ferramenta de chamados (ITSM).

Boa comunicação, organização e senso de prioridade.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

Experiência em ambiente de manufatura ou indústria.

Vivência com backup e restore de dados.

Conhecimentos em redes básicas (TCP/IP, mapeamento de rede, impressoras em rede).

Cursando ou formado em TI ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimento em ferramentas como ServiceNow, SCCM, ou similares.

title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator
description:
Job Title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator

Location: Brazil (Remote)


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator with 6+ years of experience and strong understanding of EBS R12.2 architecture .


Responsibilities:

  • Oracle WebLogic software installation and maintenance (11.x, 12.x, 14.x)
  • Installing WebLogic patches, service packs, and applying utilities like WebLogic.Admin, WebLogic.Deployer
  • WebLogic application server administration, performance monitoring, and tuning
  • Thread dump and heap dump analysis
  • Configuring LDAP and security realms (basic)
  • Developing automation scripts and integrating with HTTP servers
  • Troubleshooting JAR, EAR, WAR files
  • Understanding of EBS with 2 DB Rack System, EXADATA & ASM
  • EBS patching using ADOP (R12.2), CPU patching on DB/EBS/Tech stack
  • Cloning (Oracle DB 19c and EBS R12.2)
  • Renewing SSL and other trusted certificates on EBS
  • Understanding WebLogic server and applying patches
  • Experience with Oracle Multitenant DB architecture (19c), DR (Data Guard – Physical Standby), RMAN and DB restore
  • Shell scripting and routine Oracle Apps DBA activities


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in middleware administration , WebLogic, and Oracle Apps DBA tasks

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Java - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end para atuar em parceria com uma grande varejista.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Projetar e construir serviços utilizando a linguagem Java;

• Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para definir, projetar e entregar novos recursos;

• Acompanhar todo o ciclo de vida dos serviços (conceito, projeto, testes, lançamento e suporte);

• Assegurar que aplicativos novos e antigos satisfaçam aos padrões de qualidade;

• Realizar testes unitários de código quanto à robustez, incluindo casos extremos, usabilidade, acessibilidade e confiabilidade geral;

• Descobrir, avaliar e implementar continuamente novas tecnologias para maximizar a eficiência de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos e qualificações


Hard Skill:


• Arquitetura baseada em micro serviços;

• Metodologias Ágeis de Projetos (Scrum / Kanban);

• Java;

• Stack Spring;

• Testes Unitários e de Integração;

• Git e Gitflow;

• Containers baseados Docker;

• Jenkins;

• AWS: API Gateway, Lambda, Fargate, ECS, RDS, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, Elasticache (Redis).


Soft Skill:


• Ser comprometido e engajado na proposição e evolução das soluções tanto do ponto de vista técnico, do negócio e da experiência oferecida ao usuário.

• Ter boa capacidade de interação e comunicação com pessoas técnicas e não técnicas.

• Ter alto nível de proatividade.


Seria legal se você tivesse:


• Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis;

• Experiência com desenvolvimento baseado em event sourcing;

• Conhecimento em NodeJS/Python/Golang/Groovy;

title: Analista de sistema
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de ANALISTA DE SISTEMAS


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 16 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 10.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em curso de nível superior na área de TI;
  • Experiência exercendo atividades como desenvolvedores de aplicações Java EE 6+;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações para pelo menos um dos servidores:

- Apache Tomcat;

-JBoss/Wildfly; • Open Liberty;

-WebSphere Application Server Liberty;

-WebSphere Application Server versão 8 ou superior.


Desejável

  • Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.
  • Experiência na técnica Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) usando Cucumber ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em análise e tunning de performance de aplicações em servidores WebSphere Application Server.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem portlets, JSF (Primefaces) ou React.
  • Experiência no uso das seguintes ferramentas IBM DB2, MS SQL Server, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Maven e Gradle.

title: JR Partnership Programs Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing engineering team supporting multiple global consulting engagements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building scalable data systems, working closely with stakeholders, and delivering production-ready solutions.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and implement modern data architectures while supporting analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and distributed data systems.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows across multiple systems.
  • Deliver production-ready data solutions , from prototype to enterprise-grade systems.
  • Partner with consulting and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Lead analytics modules and clearly communicate technical outcomes.
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of data infrastructure.


Requirements

  • Intermediate to upper-intermediate English level (B2 minimum).
  • 6+ years professional experience as a Data Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or similar).
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j or similar).
  • Experience working with distributed data processing (Spark, PySpark, Hadoop).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


Nice to Have

  • Workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Data Factory, or Glue.
  • Snowflake or dimensional modeling (Star Schema).
  • Streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Azure Data Lake Storage.
  • Data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.


Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility as a CONTRACTOR.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Direct hiring with us.
  • English Class.
  • Benefits platform.
  • Continuous training communities/Certs.
  • AC points (bonus).
  • National Holidays.
  • Company Events (Colombia)
  • Salary: We don't have fixed salary ranges; we tailor the economic offer based on the candidate's salary expectations. In this case, you will let us know your monthly service fee as a CONTRACTOR, and that value will be taken into account when making the offer.


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: React/Retool Developer
description:
My US client is looking to expand their development team in Brazil. They are seeking a React Developer to work on their CMS solution. They are looking for a motivated developer with solid React experience and basic SQL skills to build and maintain internal tools using Retool. This role requires someone who can work independently, solve problems effectively, and communicate clearly in English.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain internal applications using Retool and React.
  • Write and optimize basic SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
  • Perform simple data extraction and analysis from relational databases.
  • Collaborate with product and technical stakeholders to understand requirements.
  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and propose effective solutions.
  • Deliver features with minimal supervision and manage tasks independently.
  • Maintain clean, readable, and maintainable code.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Solid experience with React (components, hooks, state management).
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL databases:
  • Writing queries (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY)
  • Creating simple functions and procedures
  • Performing data extraction
  • Ability to work independently with limited assistance.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable.
  • Proficient English communication skills (written and verbal).


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience with Retool or other low-code/internal tools platforms.
  • Experience working with APIs (REST).
  • Familiarity with Git and basic development workflows.
  • Experience working with internal business tools or dashboards.


This role is CLT and remote in Brazil. Target compenstation is R$10,000 per month

title: ANALISTA PROCESSOS REGULATORIOS JR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.

Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.

Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!



Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Realizar o monitoramento e atualização de controles em Excel, garantindo a organização e confiabilidade das informações.

• Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.

• Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.

• Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.

• Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.

• Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.

• Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.

• Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.

• Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).

• Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.


Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack .Net + React
description:
Código da Vaga: 58095


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET e React

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits


  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • FRANCÊS nível AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (comunicação, escrita e leitura)

  • Somos certificados como \"Great Place to Work\" e \"Top Employer\" em 17 países, e reconhecidos como “Top Employer” no Brasil especificamente, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo que valoriza o reconhecimento e o respeito dos funcionários
